title: Best Social Commerce Experts (2026): Sell on Social Platforms
description: How to hire a social commerce expert to set up shops and sell through social platforms, live shopping or creators: setup, content, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Social commerce experts help you sell directly on social platforms: setting up in-app shops, tagging products in posts, running live shopping events, working with creators and connecting orders to your store. Selling where people already scroll can shorten the path to purchase. Projects go wrong when product catalogs do not sync, shop policies are broken, or content feels like constant advertising. This guide helps you sell on social platforms the right way.

faq.a: Several major social platforms offer shopping features, with availability depending on country. Check which ones operate in your markets.

faq.q: Do I need a separate store?
faq.a: Usually your existing store connects to the social shop, syncing products and orders.
Live video where hosts show products and viewers can buy during the stream.
Usually it adds a sales channel. Your own website remains important for brand and customer data.
